### Observed differences

- Activity A01 was not observed at all in the earlier window (0 of 200 traces) but appears in the later window in about 31 of 200 traces (about 15 in 100), with about 0.29 occurrences per trace and repeats in about 8 in 100 traces. [OCC001]
- In the later window, A01's outgoing transitions lead to A09 in about 54 in 100 cases and to A10 in about 46 in 100; in the earlier window A01 had no observed outgoing transitions. [DIR001]
- A08's outgoing transitions, earlier confined to A15 (about 49 in 100), A11 (26), A12 (12), A13 (7) and A14 (6), now also include A01 (about 8 in 100), with the shares going to A11–A14 each 2–3 points lower. [DIR005]
- A01 co-occurs with the other traced activities only in the later window: in about 15–16 in 100 traces with A02, A04, A05, A08 and A10 (essentially every A01 trace), about 13 in 100 with A09, A11, A12 and A15, but only about 5–9 in 100 with A13 and A14; earlier, no trace contained A01 together with any of these activities. [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011]
- When present, A01 sits in the later-middle part of the trace (mean normalized position about 0.66, median about 0.70); it had no position distribution earlier. [POS001]
- Participation also shifted moderately for existing activities: A07 fell from about 18 to 10 in 100 traces (36 → 20), mean occurrences of A12 fell from about 0.49 to 0.32, of A13 from 0.28 to 0.18 and of A14 from 0.23 to 0.11, while A02, A04 and A05 each rose from about 47 to 54 in 100 traces (94 → 107) and A06 from about 12 to 16. [OCC007, OCC012, OCC013, OCC014, OCC002, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006]
- A few lag distributions between existing activities moved (for example A10→A11 is now mostly 3 positions apart instead of 5, and A09→A12 mostly 2 instead of 4), but these rest on only about 10–20 observed pairs each. [LAG049, LAG043]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that A01 became an executed step of the process in the later window: it runs in about 15 in 100 later traces after being absent from the 200 earlier traces, is reached directly from A08 (about 8 in 100 of A08's outgoing transitions), and leads on to A09 or A10 in a roughly 54/46 split, so it behaves like an additional step in the segment after A08 that feeds the existing A09/A10 branch. The change is shown directly and consistently by occurrence, successor, position and co-occurrence indicators, each with empirical strength near 0.99, and the co-occurrence items place A01 inside the A02/A04/A05/A08 context in the later window only. A competing explanation the evidence cannot fully rule out is that A01 existed before at a rate too low to appear in 200 traces, in which case the data show only that it became far more frequent rather than that it is structurally new; the evidence also provides no screening baseline against which to compare the number of qualifying items. [OCC001, DIR001, DIR005, POS001, REL004, REL006]

Other differences: participation and repetition of A07, A12, A13 and A14 decreased modestly while A02, A04, A05 and A06 increased, and some lag distributions between existing activities shifted; the evidence cannot establish whether these shifts are consequences of A01's appearance or independent changes, and several of them rest on fewer than about 20 observations. [OCC007, OCC012, OCC013, OCC014, OCC002, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, LAG049, LAG043]
